title: Test Lifecycle default
summary:
Added Open Kit functionality to the sketchpad with file/folder/remote kit kinds, environment-aware availability, and full E2E test coverage.

## Changes

### semio/sketchpad/index.tsx
- Added `openKit(kind)` method on SketchpadStore handling "folder", "file", "remote", "temporary" kit kinds via factory pattern
- Added `"semio.sketchpad.openKit"` command in `executeCommand` switch
- Added `openKit` in `useSketchpadCommands()` hook
- Extended `SketchpadKitKindAvailability` with `folder: boolean` and `file: boolean` fields
- Updated `availableKitKinds()` to populate `folder` and `file` fields based on factory availability
- Rewrote `HomeToolbarOpen` FC to use `openKit` command with buttons per `availableKitKinds`
- Added `"open"` to toolbar group IDs array for visibility
- Added `FolderIcon` case in `getGroupIcon` for the open group
- Added browser `fileKitStoreFactory` using File System Access API (showOpenFilePicker) with fallback to file input
- Added browser `remoteKitStoreFactory` using SessionKitStore connecting via HTTP+WS
- Fixed Playwright test locale to `de-DE` for German i18n assertions
- Fixed language default initialization to detect from `navigator.language` instead of hardcoding "en"
- Explicitly set language to German in Home test selection state section for deterministic i18n testing
- Updated `expectOnlyLeftAndRightPanelTogglesInNavbar` to accept settings/chat toggles (now always rendered)
- Added E2E test section "Open Toolbar Group" covering: group toggle visibility, open buttons per environment, availableKitKinds assertions, openKit error for unavailable folder kind

### semio/sketchpad/vite.config.ts
- Added `.js` suffix aliases for `use-sync-external-store/shim` to fix zustand 504 dep optimization errors

### semio/desktop/renderer.tsx
- Added all four kit store factory types (temporary, file, folder, remote) for Electron desktop environment

### elements/ui/index.tsx
- Added "open" translations to EN toolbar.parent and toolbar.group sections
- Added "open" translations to DE toolbar.parent and toolbar.group sections ("Öffnen")

## Pre-existing Test Failures (not caused by this ticket)
- Kit test: File row for zip fixture root file not visible
- Design test: Selection additive toggle doesn't update activeInteraction
- Type test: Element not editable in verifyTypeCreateKeepsNewNameInsteadOfFocusedModelValue
